name: Protein Kulfi
ingredients: Water, milk solids, fructo-oligosaccharide, polydextrose, enzyme (beta-galactosidase), emulsifiers (471, 491), stabilizers (407, 410, 412, 415), acidity regulator (330), artificial flavouring substances (mango), colours (102, 110), sweetener (960), probiotic strains (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium animalis minimum 107 CFU* per mL). *Colony Forming Unit. Allergen Information: Contains milk.
